svg.title: Ruflo Orbital console theme workflow
svg.desc: 38 second vector replay with all 456 captured frames. Boot, main menu, palettes, customization, persistence, import and resize.
svg.text: 04 / CUSTOMIZE / draft leaves active palette unchanged
05 / MOTION / half speed globe and orchestration
06 / SAVE / custom Night Shift palette applied
07 / REOPEN / saved selection restored from disk
08 / IMPORT JSON / portable Arctic preset applied
10 / RESIZE / 80 columns, stacked editor and preview
RENDERER DEMO / native host and AI generation unverified
